bootstrap_support_definition: For every UID-cluster replicate and comparison, bootstrap._pair_metrics recomputes (replicate_left_credits > 0) | (replicate_right_credits > 0) over the fixed decision-cell universe.
bootstrap_zero_cell_behavior: Cells absent after UID resampling remain aligned in the fixed decision-cell universe with zero credit, but are then removed from Kendall input when both comparison routes have zero credit in that replicate.
constant_and_nan_behavior: Support sizes below two return NaN explicitly. For larger supports, scipy.stats.kendalltau(..., variant='b', nan_policy='omit') is called; constant vectors can therefore return NaN and summaries silently omit NaN values.
full_sample_support_definition: Union of decision cells with positive full-sample credited_conversion_mass on the left or right route.
kendall_input_normalization: No comparison-specific normalization is applied. Both paths use decision_cell_score = credited_conversion_mass / eligible_impression_count; route-total normalization is used only for allocation-TV vectors.
replicate_support_field_semantics: common_active_support_count in bootstrap draws is replicate-specific; the identically named field in point results is full-sample-specific.
suspected_root_cause: Replicate-specific support drift: bootstrap._pair_metrics redefines Kendall support from resampled credits instead of evaluating every replicate on the full-sample union-positive support.
ties_behavior: Both paths request Kendall tau-b from SciPy. No jitter or tie breaking is applied to Kendall inputs. Top-k tie handling is separate and deterministic.
